projectContext: Sprint 7 focuses on caption system resilience, adaptive intelligence, and operational tooling. Sprint 6 delivered thread safety, per-video timing, language audit trails, format telemetry, config validation, quality-weighted matching, timing epsilon, cache validation, normalizer edge cases, and integration tests. Sprint 7 advances: (1) Segment-level parsing error recovery for partial caption success, (2) Adaptive format ordering based on historical success rates, (3) Error categorization with circuit breaker patterns, (4) Metrics export and structured reporting, (5) Standalone validation CLI for testing configurations, (6) Batch pre-check optimization with channel-aware caching, (7) Network error pattern detection and early abort, (8) Caption timing integration into match confidence, (9) Channel-level caption availability patterns, (10) Stress tests for high-concurrency caption fetching.

userStories.title: Add segment-level error recovery to caption parsers
userStories.description: Caption parsers (VTT, SRT, JSON3) currently fail the entire video if one segment is malformed. Implement graceful degradation that skips invalid segments while preserving valid ones, improving success rate for videos with partially corrupted caption data.
acceptanceCriteria: Modify _parse_vtt() to wrap each segment in try/except, logging skipped segment index
Modify _parse_srt() to continue parsing after malformed segment block
Modify _parse_json3() to skip events with missing required fields (tStartMs, segs)
Track skipped_segments in CaptionResult with list of (index, reason) tuples
Add partial_recovery flag to CaptionResult when segments were skipped but result is usable
Tests verify: video with 100 segments and 5 corrupted still returns 95 valid segments
userStories.notes: Implemented ParseResult dataclass to return both segments and skipped_segments. Added partial_recovery flag to CaptionResult. All three parsers (VTT, SRT, JSON3) now wrap segment parsing in try/except and log skipped segments. Tests verify 100 segments with 5 corrupted returns 95 valid (283 tests pass).

userStories.title: Implement adaptive format ordering from historical success rates
userStories.description: The preferred_formats order is currently static. Use format_success_counts metrics from previous runs to dynamically reorder formats, trying historically successful formats first to reduce latency.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CaptionMetrics.get_optimal_format_order() returning formats sorted by success rate
Persist format success rates in caption cache metadata for cross-run learning
CaptionFetcher.fetch_single() uses adaptive order when config.adaptive_format_order=true
Log format reordering: 'Adaptive format order: vtt (95%), json3 (80%), srt (60%)'
Config option caption_first.adaptive_format_order (default: true)
Tests verify format with 90% success rate tried before format with 50% success rate
userStories.notes: Implemented get_optimal_format_order() in CaptionMetrics, save/load_format_statistics() in CaptionCache, apply_adaptive_format_order() in CaptionFetcher. Added adaptive_format_order config option (default: true). Metrics data prioritized over cache. Integrated in CaptionStage: cache loads historical success rates before batch fetch, saves updated statistics after. All 110 caption/config tests pass.

userStories.title: Add error categorization with type-specific retry budgets
userStories.description: All caption fetch errors currently share the same retry budget. Network errors should retry more aggressively than parse errors (which are unlikely to succeed on retry). Categorize errors and apply appropriate retry strategies.
acceptanceCriteria: Create CaptionErrorCategory enum: NETWORK, TIMEOUT, PARSE, UNAVAILABLE, RATE_LIMIT
Map exception types to categories in fetch_single() error handling
Add per-category retry budgets to config: {network: 3, timeout: 2, parse: 1, unavailable: 0}
Track error_category_counts in CaptionMetrics for debugging
Log error category with retry decision: 'NETWORK error, retry 2/3' vs 'PARSE error, no retry'
Tests verify parse errors skip retries while network errors use full budget
userStories.notes: Implemented CaptionErrorCategory enum with 5 types, categorize_caption_error() function, per-category retry budgets in config, error_category_counts tracking in CaptionMetrics, category-aware logging in _with_retry(). 18 new tests added (all pass). NETWORK errors use budget 3, PARSE errors use budget 1, UNAVAILABLE never retries.

userStories.title: Create structured metrics export to JSON file
userStories.description: CaptionMetrics.summary() only prints to console. Add structured export capability for historical tracking, dashboards, and cross-project analysis.
acceptanceCriteria: Add CaptionMetrics.export_json(path) writing all metrics to timestamped JSON file
Include run metadata: timestamp, project_path, config snapshot, video_count
Add --export-caption-metrics flag to CLI writing to project/caption_metrics.json
Export includes all sub-metrics: timing, formats, languages, errors, cache validation
JSON schema documented in docstring with example output structure
Tests verify exported JSON is valid and contains all expected fields
userStories.notes: Implemented export_json() method with full JSON schema documented in docstring. Added --export-caption-metrics CLI flag. Export includes run metadata (timestamp, project_path, config snapshot, video_count) and all sub-metrics (timing, formats, languages, errors, coverage, quality, cache_validation, pre_check, raw_metrics). Fixed error_category_counts serialization bug in to_dict/from_dict. Added 21 tests (18 export + 3 serialization). All 322 caption_fetcher tests pass.

userStories.title: Build standalone caption configuration validation CLI
userStories.description: Users cannot test caption-first configuration without running the full pipeline. Create a lightweight validation command that checks config and tests fetching a few sample videos.
acceptanceCriteria: Add 'python main.py --validate-captions' mode that runs config validation only
Validation checks: language codes, format preferences, timeout values, cache path writability
With --validate-captions --test-fetch N: fetch captions for N random sample videos
Print validation summary: 'Config valid. Test fetch: 3/3 success, avg 2.1s, json3 format'
Return exit code 0 for valid config, 1 for validation errors, 2 for test fetch failures
Tests verify CLI validates config correctly and reports test fetch results
userStories.notes: Implemented CaptionConfigValidationResult, TestFetchResult, TestFetchSummary dataclasses. Added validate_caption_config() function with comprehensive checks (language codes, format preferences, timeout values, cache path writability, retry budgets). Added run_caption_test_fetch() for sample video testing. CLI flags --validate-captions and --test-fetch N added to args.py. main.py integration with proper exit codes (0=valid, 1=validation error, 2=test fetch failure). 29 new tests added (all pass). Full CLI output shows check status icons.

userStories.title: Implement batch pre-check optimization with channel caching
userStories.description: Pre-check availability runs separately for each video. Batch pre-checks by channel to reduce API calls, since channels typically either have captions for all videos or none.
acceptanceCriteria: Add channel_caption_pattern cache: {channel_id: {has_captions: bool, confidence: float}}
Group videos by channel_id before pre-check, check representative sample per channel
Skip individual pre-checks for channels with >90% confidence in pattern
Config option caption_first.batch_precheck_by_channel (default: true)
Track pre_check_batched_count in metrics showing API calls saved
Tests verify 50 videos from same channel use 5 sample checks instead of 50
userStories.notes: Feature already fully implemented: ChannelCaptionPattern dataclass (line 3386), batch_precheck_by_channel() method (line 3081), config options in download.py (batch_precheck_by_channel, batch_precheck_confidence, batch_precheck_min_samples, batch_precheck_sample_size), metrics tracking (pre_check_batched_total/skipped/checked, api_calls_saved), cache persistence (save/load_channel_patterns). 31 comprehensive tests in test_batch_precheck.py all pass, including test_50_videos_same_channel_uses_5_checks verifying acceptance criteria.

userStories.title: Add network error pattern detection with early abort
userStories.description: When 30%+ videos fail with the same network error (gateway timeout, geoblocking), the pipeline wastes time retrying. Detect error patterns early and offer to abort or switch strategies.
acceptanceCriteria: Track error patterns: {error_signature: [video_ids]} during batch fetch
Trigger pattern alert when same error affects >30% of first 10 videos
Log pattern detection: 'Pattern detected: 403 Forbidden (8/10 videos) - possible geoblocking'
Config option caption_first.abort_on_error_pattern (default: warn)
Modes: 'abort' (stop immediately), 'warn' (log and continue), 'skip' (no detection)
Tests verify pattern detection triggers at threshold with correct error signature
userStories.notes: Implemented ErrorPatternResult dataclass, ErrorPatternDetector class (thread-safe, signature extraction, cause inference), ErrorPatternAbortError exception. Config options: abort_on_error_pattern (warn/abort/skip), error_pattern_threshold (0.3), error_pattern_sample_size (10). Integration in fetch_captions_batch() with pattern logging, progress callback, and metrics tracking. 30 new tests in 4 test classes all pass.

userStories.title: Integrate caption timing validation into match confidence
userStories.description: Caption timing validation (US-007 Sprint 6) currently only logs warnings. When timing issues are detected (exceeds duration, low coverage), apply confidence penalty in matching stage.
acceptanceCriteria: Add timing_penalty_factor to CaptionResult based on validate_timing() results
Penalty formula: 1.0 - (exceeds_ratio * 0.3) - ((1 - coverage_ratio) * 0.2)
Pass timing_penalty through text_metadata to MatchStage
MatchStage applies: adjusted_confidence = raw * quality_weight * timing_penalty
Config option matching.apply_timing_penalty (default: true)
Tests verify poor timing (50% coverage, 20% exceeds) reduces confidence by ~25%
userStories.notes: Implemented timing_penalty_factor property on CaptionResult using validate_timing() results. Added exceeds_ratio and coverage_ratio to TimingValidationResult. CaptionStage now validates timing and stores timing_penalty in caption_results and text_metadata. Added apply_timing_penalty() in scoring.py, integrated in TieredMatcher at all 4 scoring locations. Config option matching.apply_timing_penalty (default: true) added to config.py and config.yaml. 19 new tests added: 10 in test_caption_fetcher.py (timing_penalty_factor) and 9 in test_scoring.py (apply_timing_penalty). All 454 tests pass.

userStories.title: Track channel-level caption availability patterns
userStories.description: Some YouTube channels consistently have captions while others never do. Track channel patterns to predict caption availability and prioritize fetch order.
acceptanceCriteria: Add ChannelCaptionPattern dataclass: channel_id, videos_checked, captions_found, success_rate
Persist channel patterns in caption cache for cross-project learning
Add CaptionMetrics.get_channel_statistics() returning top/bottom channels by success
Sort fetch order: high-success channels first when config.prioritize_by_channel=true
Print channel summary: 'Top channels: UCabc (100%), UCdef (95%). Bottom: UCghi (0%)'
Tests verify channel patterns update correctly after batch fetch
userStories.notes: Leveraged existing ChannelCaptionPattern from US-006 (already has channel_id, videos_checked, captions_found, success_rate, persistence). Added: CaptionMetrics.channel_patterns field, set_channel_patterns(), get_channel_statistics() returning top/bottom channels, get_channel_summary() for formatted output. Added prioritize_by_channel config option (default: true) to CaptionFirstConfig and config.yaml. Added _sort_videos_by_channel_success() and set_video_channel_map() to CaptionFetcher for fetch ordering. Updated summary() to print channel availability. Added to_dict/from_dict serialization. 18 new tests in 4 test classes all pass.

userStories.title: Create stress tests for high-concurrency caption fetching
userStories.description: Caption fetching with 8+ parallel workers hasn't been stress-tested for edge cases: race conditions, resource exhaustion, error cascade. Add comprehensive stress test suite.
acceptanceCriteria: Create TestCaptionStressSuite class in tests/test_caption_stress.py
Test: 100 videos with 16 workers completes without deadlock or memory leak
Test: 50% error rate doesn't cause cascade failure or worker starvation
Test: mixed slow/fast videos (0.1s to 5s latency) maintains fair scheduling
Test: abrupt cancellation during batch fetch cleans up all worker threads
Add pytest marker @pytest.mark.stress for selective execution
userStories.notes: Created TestCaptionStressSuite class with 8 stress tests covering all acceptance criteria plus additional thread safety scenarios. Tests use tracemalloc for memory leak detection, threading.active_count() for thread leak detection, and time-based assertions for deadlock detection. All tests use @pytest.mark.stress marker for selective execution. Tests include: 100 videos/16 workers (memory/deadlock), 50% error rate (cascade/starvation), mixed latency (fair scheduling), abrupt cancellation (thread cleanup), concurrent metrics updates (lock correctness), progress callback safety (exception handling), worker isolation (batch independence), rapid sequential batches (resource accumulation). All 8 tests pass in 3.98s.
